name: Ball Toy
summary: Striped beach or play ball with three coloured panels; for play and summer scenes. anim bounce bounces it.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the ball rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size; use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: color2
params.note: second stripe colour (third stripe is blue)

params.name: anim
params.note: bounce = bounces on the ground with a shrinking shadow; the others are gentle motions

author: krakujs
